subject: Orbit Health — cloud purchasing & marketplace next steps
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@orbithealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap — cloud purchasing & marketplace next steps

Hi Asha — great to speak earlier. Quick recap and the next steps we discussed so the procurement team has what they need: 

Recap from today's call:
- Primary goal: pilot Redwood inference for anonymized clinical summarization (initial 2k active users).
- Preferred billing model: Orbit leaning toward PO-based invoicing, but open to marketplace if it simplifies internal procurement.
- Marketplace interest: GCP marketplace mentioned as preferred by infra/finance (they centralize all cloud charges there).
- Compliance: you asked for SOC 2 Type II evidence and an outline of data residency controls.

Immediate next steps (owner in parentheses):
1) I'll send a PO-friendly quote and SOW template for your procurement team to review (Neha) — attached: Redwood-quote-v1.pdf, Orbit_SOW_template.pdf.
2) Please confirm the procurement contact and preferred invoice cadence (procurement@orbithealth.com suggested) (Asha).
3) We'll check marketplace enablement requirements for GCP (and confirm if AWS/Azure are options) and share technical/marketplace documentation (Karthik).
4) If legal needs an NDA/SLA/redline window, we'll stand up a dedicated thread for legal engagement (Marissa).

Proposed timeline: if Orbit can confirm PO route and procurement contact this week, we can deliver a PO-ready agreement and internal billing instructions by 09/20. If you prefer GCP Marketplace, we'll surface any enablement lead times (typically 2–3 weeks depending on vendor onboarding).

Would you like us to schedule a 30-minute procurement sync with procurement@orbithealth.com and our Finance Ops lead this week?

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0128

Attachments: Redwood-quote-v1.pdf (PDF, 2 pages); Orbit_SOW_template.pdf (DOCX, 3 pages)

From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@orbithealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@orbithealth.com
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — cloud purchasing & marketplace next steps

Thanks Neha — solid recap. A few clarifications from procurement/finance side: 

- Procurement preference: Orbit historically buys via PO (net 30). Finance will push for PO unless marketplace significantly shortens the onboarding timeline or provides better billing reconciliation.
- Marketplace preference: GCP Marketplace is preferred for the pilot because our billing teams already reconcile there. AWS Marketplace would be a secondary option; Azure is unlikely for this group.
- Invoicing cadence: Net 30 is standard. We need a PO + invoice PDF that our AP team can match to the PO.
- Compliance: please send SOC 2 Type II report and a statement of data handling. Our security team will need those before procurement signs off.
- Timeline: we are aiming for a procurement decision by 2027-09-22 to align with quarter planning.

Procurement contact: procurement@orbithealth.com (this is the central inbox; I'll loop in the specific buyer after your follow-up). Legal will want to review the SOW, but can do that after procurement confirms the commercial path.

If you can share the PO-ready document and confirm whether Redwood can be sold via GCP Marketplace with PO invoicing (metered or committed usage) that would help us evaluate.

Appreciate it — Asha
Asha Patel
Head of Product Operations | Orbit Health
asha.patel@orbithealth.com

Hi Asha / procurement team — looping in a few quick answers and proposed next steps so we can keep to your 09/22 decision timeline. 

Answers to your items:
- PO invoicing & cadence: we can support PO (net 30). We will generate an invoice PDF for AP to match to a PO; we can also provide monthly statements if that helps reconciliation.
- Marketplace + PO: on GCP Marketplace, vendors can accept Marketplace procurement while still supporting PO-style invoicing using reseller/metering arrangements — there are a couple implementation paths. We need to confirm whether Orbit needs metered on-demand billing or a committed monthly invoice. Karthik will confirm the technical implications.
- Compliance artifacts: attached is our SOC 2 Type II cover letter and a short data-handling summary. If legal needs the full report we can arrange an NDA and provide the SOC package (Marissa).

Next steps (owners & timing):
1) Neha: I attached a PO-ready quote and a pre-populated SOW template for your review (attached). Please confirm bill-to details and PO numbering structure so we can mirror it on the invoice (due today if you want the docs for internal review).
2) Karthik: will follow up by EOD with notes on GCP Marketplace enablement options (metered vs committed) and estimated onboarding lead times.
3) Marissa: will stand up the legal thread if Orbit wants the SOC package under NDA.
4) Proposed procurement sync: Wed 09/15 10:00–10:30 PT (we can move if needed). Please confirm or propose an alternate time.

We want to make the evaluation as frictionless as possible — happy to do a short technical/finance walkthrough with your procurement team.

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com

I suggested Wed 09/15 10:00 PT for a quick procurement/finance sync; Asha is aiming for a decision by 09/22. Happy to join the call and run the commercial portion.

Thanks — Neha
